script_segment: A report by the Institute for the Study of War found that Russian advances in 2024 were slow and costly.
Russian-held territory grew from about 7% in 2021 to about 22% in March 2022, and stood close to 18% in 2024.
The Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant, the largest in Europe, has been under Russian control since March 2022.

script_segment: In 2022 the front moved fast, in 2023 it barely moved, and in 2024 it crept slowly west.
Three years on, the front line is still moving, one village at a time.
